entry.title: Release 2026-09-01
entry.summary: First release. The gap against an ideal flight, computed for every flight that passes the quality gates in the ECAC area over the covered period, split into a lateral and a vertical component, with the phase attribution of the vertical part and a context page for the external figures. Covers 2026-01-01 to 2026-07-20, methodology v1.0.
